lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A stochastic distribution of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the fifth gill slit. Notable spatial arrangement includes a vertical triad of large, diffuse blobs in the right-center quadrant and a dense cluster of smaller, high-intensity spots immediately posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, fragmented vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with larger circular blobs to create a non-uniform grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature across the upper-third of the frame, defined by a sharp intensity gradient showing high-luminance on the superior margin and deep shadowing on the inferior margin.
